in_marathi.name: Madhunandan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sweet, Delightful, Protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhunandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madhunandan is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Madhu' meaning sweet or honey, and 'Nandana' meaning delightful or charming. In Hindu mythology, Madhunandan is the name of Lord Krishna, who is considered the embodiment of love, compassion and mischief. He is known to be the protector of his people and is revered for his sweet and delightful nature.
